name: Power roll
summary: Roll 2d10 and add a characteristic: 11 or lower is tier 1, 12 to 16 tier 2, 17 or higher tier 3. An edge adds 2.
source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 1 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Winded and dying
summary: A creature is winded at half its Stamina or below, and a hero is dying at 0 Stamina or below.
source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 10 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Censor: Wrath
summary: Wrath equal to your Victories when the fight starts, then 2 at the start of each of your turns.
description: Your Judgment marks a foe. The first time each round that a judged creature damages you, and the first time each round you damage a judged creature, you gain 1 wrath.
source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

properties.quote: As a censor, you're at your best against the strongest foes. Your judgment terrifies heretics, stops enemies in their tracks, and even hurls them across the battlefield.
properties.gain_text: Wrath equal to your Victories when the fight starts, then 2 at the start of each of your turns.
properties.unique_text: Your Judgment marks a foe. The first time each round that a judged creature damages you, and the first time each round you damage a judged creature, you gain 1 wrath.
properties.ends_text: You lose what's left at the end of the encounter.
properties.outside_text: You can't gain wrath, but you can use an ability that costs it without spending any, once until you earn a Victory or finish a respite.

name: Conduit: Piety
summary: Piety equal to your Victories when the fight starts, then 1d3 at the start of each of your turns.
description: Before you roll for piety you can pray. On a 1 you gain 1 more but anger the gods and take 1d6 + your level psychic damage that can't be reduced. On a 2 you gain 1 more. On a 3 you gain 2 more and can activate a domain effect.
source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

properties.quote: As a conduit, you heal and buff your allies, and debuff your foes while smiting them with divine magic.

name: Elementalist: Essence
summary: Essence equal to your Victories when the fight starts, then 2 at the start of each of your turns.
description: The first time each round that you or a creature within 10 squares takes damage that isn't untyped or holy, you gain 1 essence.
source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

summary: Ferocity equal to your Victories when the fight starts, then 1d3 at the start of each of your turns.
description: Getting hurt feeds you. The first time each round you take damage, you gain 1 ferocity, and the first time you become winded or are dying in an encounter, you gain 1d3.

source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Talent: Clarity
summary: Clarity equal to your Victories when the fight starts, then 1d3 at the start of each of your turns.
description: You can spend clarity you don't have, down to minus (1 + your Reason). Below 0 you are strained, and at the end of each of your turns you take 1 damage per negative point. The first time each round a creature is force moved, you gain 1 clarity.
source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

properties.quote: As a talent, you are limited only by the strength of your mind. But the ability to wield multiple powers at once and change reality at will involves a gamble.

summary: Drama equal to your Victories when the fight starts, then 1d3 at the start of each of your turns.
description: The story pays you: 2 the first time three or more heroes use an ability on the same turn, 2 the first time any hero is made winded, 3 whenever a creature in your line of effect rolls a natural 19 or 20, and 10 when you or another hero dies. Dead with 30 drama, you come back with 1 Stamina.
source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Wrath in the chapel
summary: An example fight for the censor's pop-up book, written for this package.
source: custom

properties.title: Wrath in the chapel

acts.s: not judged, so no wrath back

properties.hint: **Click the heretic** to be stabbed, **the censor** to strike back, **the cultist** for a big strike, and **the hourglass** to start your turn. The heretic is judged: hurting each other pays wrath once a round each way.

name: Piety in the crypt
summary: An example fight for the conduit's pop-up book, written for this package.
source: custom

properties.title: Piety in the crypt
properties.hint: **Tick “Pray”** and **turn the hourglass**: a 1 angers the gods, a 3 pays 2 more. **Click the skeleton** to be clawed, **the archer** for a holy strike, and **the conduit** to heal.

summary: An example fight for the elementalist's pop-up book, written for this package.
source: custom

properties.title: Essence among the embers

acts.b: Hurl a firebolt at the golem

start: Fire, stone and storm, to me.
win: Back to the elements with you.

properties.hint: **Click the imp** for fire, **the golem** for a plain slam, **yourself** to hurl a firebolt. Fire, cold or lightning near you pays essence, but only the first time each round, and the golem’s untyped slam never does.
